Our Products

A growing collection of apps designed to make everyday tasks simpler.

Expense Management

SplitMate

SplitMate is an intuitive mobile application created by Fyndra Labs that simplifies shared bill splitting, group balances, and debt resolution.

Split Expenses Easily

Equal splits, percentages, or exact amounts

Track Balances

Instant overview of who owes what with zero math errors

Manage Groups

Organize trips, housemates, or dinners seamlessly

Invite & Sync

Collaborate in real-time with group members

Keep Organized

Categorize spending & attach receipt details

Transparent Calculations

Smart debt simplification reduces total transactions
